newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-FAIRCLOUGH BEATS FOG TO CLAIM WPGA LEAD.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-FAIRCLOUGH BEATS FOG TO CLAIM WPGA LEAD.

text.p: Lora Fairclough's hot putter helped her to a six-under-par 66 on Thursday and the lead in the fog-hit first round of the WPGA championship of Europe.
When play was abandoned for the day with 27 players still on the course, Fairclough was a shot ahead of three more Britons -- Catriona Matthew, Wendy Dicks and Trish Johnson.
Fairclough was in superb form on the greens, claiming three of her eight birdies with putts of more than 25 feet.
Marie-Laure de Lorenzi of France and Britain's Anna Radford were two shots off the pace on 68 while Alison Nicholas, winner of last month's U.S. Open, stayed in touch with a 69.
World number three Laura Davies birdied the long 18th but had to settle for a 71.
